facts.fact: Giardino Scotto is the garden within the former Cittadella Nuova on Lungarno Fibonacci. Santa Maria della Spina is a Gothic riverside church reassembled higher because of flooding, with original sculptures replaced by casts and originals conserved elsewhere.
